title: Hezbollah MPs, Rivals Clash in Parliament Over Israel
detail: The second day of a general parliamentary debate session saw a heated verbal clash between Hezbollah lawmakers and political rivals over the party's arms and the southern escalation. Hezbollah MP Ihab Hamadeh told opponents to 'Go check what the Israelis said about Ali al-Taher. Shame on you,' prompting independent MP Waddah Sadek to retort, 'Go check who brought the Israelis into the country!' Lebanese Forces MP Ziad Hawat intervened, telling Hamadeh 'Enough with showing off. Go show off in front of the Israelis,' after which Hamadeh called rival MPs 'the cronies of Israel' and Hawat responded 'You have brought Israel into the country.' The exchange underscored the deepening political rift over Hezbollah's weapons ahead of the disarmament debate mandated by the June framework.

title: Lebanese, Israeli Ambassadors Meet in Washington to Discuss Framework Implementation
detail: Lebanon's Ambassador Nada Mouawad and Israel's Ambassador Yechiel Leiter met at the U.S. State Department to discuss recent developments and continued implementation of the U.S.-sponsored trilateral framework agreed between Lebanon and Israel in June. A State Department official said the meeting would cover 'current developments,' describing the framework as the only viable mechanism for restoring Lebanese sovereignty and Israeli security. Lebanese officials said no decisions or agreements were expected, describing the meeting as a way to keep communication open following recent setbacks. The formal eighth round of Lebanon-Israel negotiations, originally due in Rome in September, has been postponed to October. Separately, President Aoun traveled to Paris the same day for talks and preparatory discussions on army aid.

title: Overnight Detonations and Artillery Strikes Hit South Lebanon
detail: Israeli forces carried out controlled detonations overnight into Wednesday in the border towns of Teeri and al-Mansouri, while artillery shelled Kfartebnit, Marjaayoun, Baraashit and Wadi Zebqine. Israeli strikes also targeted Wadi Zebqine and the area between Mayfadoun and Zawtar al-Sharqiyeh. No casualties were reported. The activity came as Lebanese and Israeli ambassadors met in Washington the same day to discuss the framework's implementation.
